AI interviews are taking over the job market...

And somehow they're even worse than regular interviews.

In this video, I hop on an AI recruiter call and quickly discover that it isn't really an interview at all. It's just a chatbot collecting information while pretending to be a recruiter.

No company details.
No real answers.
No transparency.
Just endless questions and a growing database.

The funniest part?

The AI eventually explains all the ways AI recruiting could be abused... and basically argues against itself.
